sources.title: PolyTAO — AI Model — Paramus Documentation
sources.snippet: A Transformer-Assisted Oriented pretrained model for on-demand polymer generation (conditional generative LLM). Generates polymers with 15 predefined fundamental properties. Achieves ~99.3% chemical validity in top-1 generation.
